sources.entry: Tuwunel - High-performance and feature-rich chat server for Matrix, and the successor to conduwuit (fork of Conduit). (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 deb/Docker/Nix/Rust

summary.one_liner: Tuwunel is a Rust-written Matrix homeserver (an alternative to Synapse) and the official successor to conduwuit, a fork of Conduit.
summary.what_it_does: Tuwunel is a Matrix homeserver written entirely in Rust, intended to be used in place of Synapse with Matrix clients, bridges, and bots. The README says it fully implements the Matrix Specification for all but the most niche uses. It is distributed through GitHub releases, Docker images (DockerHub and GHCR), static binaries, deb and RPM packages, an Apt repository, a COPR repository, AUR packages, a Nix package and NixOS module, an Alpine package, and a Gentoo ebuild. Configuration is done by copying and editing a tuwunel-example.toml file, where server_name and database_path must be set. The README gives a Caddy reverse-proxy example for TLS and serving the Element web client. The first registered user becomes server admin, and a registration_token can be set to restrict sign-ups. It documents migration paths in place from conduwuit, its forks, and Conduit, using a RocksDB database; migration from Synapse is listed as not yet supported.
use_cases: run a private Matrix server for a community or company
deploy Matrix on NixOS or Debian
how_to_run: Copy and edit tuwunel-example.toml, setting server_name and database_path
Configure TLS, e.g. with the Caddy reverse proxy example in the README
Start the server, connect a Matrix client, and register the first user (who becomes admin)
notable: Official successor to conduwuit, with in-place database migration from Conduit and conduwuit forks
Broad packaging: Docker, static binaries, deb/RPM, Apt, COPR, AUR, Nix, Alpine, Gentoo
Container tags :latest, :preview, and :main offer different update cadences
Downgrades are generally blocked by a guard when unsafe
Primarily sponsored by the government of Switzerland, per the README
caveats: Migration from Synapse is not yet supported according to the README
Migrating between two other Conduit forks can permanently corrupt the database, so backups are strongly advised
Migration from Conduit requires care with media layout as noted in the deploying guide
